Name: Zechariah, Son of Jeberechiah
Summary: Zechariah, son of Jeberechiah, was one of the two faithful witnesses Isaiah took when he recorded the prophecy of Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
KeyStory: Isaiah recorded the prophecy on a great roll with Zechariah and Uriah the priest as faithful witnesses.
LifeLesson: A faithful witness does not need a large part — only a true one.
